title: [Agent] we are tinkering with the jellyfin for android TV ui...

messages.content:
[Agent] we are tinkering with the jellyfin for android TV ui, if you compare the master and custom-ui-changes branch you can see all the changes so far, we have imported logo paths from SVG files and created some gradients. I was working on the background with another model, currently it shows the currently selected movies images but I want it to use a simple gradient using the darker colours from this pallet:

  --accent: 184, 242, 197;         /* #B8F2C5 */
  --accent-off: 109, 132, 114;     /* #6D8472 */
  --dark: 27, 36, 29;              /* #1B241D */
  --darkest: 19, 28, 22;           /* #131C16 */
  --dark-highlight: 59, 69, 60;    /* #3B453C */
  --dark-apparent: 31, 41, 33;     /* #1F2921 */
[Agent] what file should we edit to change the background?

Discovering relevant files...
Generating plan...
To change the background, you should edit the `colors.xml` file located in the `app/src/main/res/values` directory. This file contains color definitions that can be used throughout your application, including for backgrounds.
